description: Renew a managed certificate now, without waiting for the renewal window

certificate.description: Certificate name, as it appears in the store

force.description: Renew even if the certificate is nowhere near expiry. Counts against the CA's rate limits.

api_key.description: DigiCert CertCentral API key. Only needed for certificates issued by the digicert backend.

config_dir.description: certbot configuration directory, if the issuer does not use the default

organization_id.description: DigiCert organisation ID. Only needed for the digicert backend.

api_url.description: DigiCert CertCentral API base, for the EU endpoint or a proxy
